**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, licence scope).**

- **Clause reviewed:** Section 1.4 (p0008–p0009) — HDI grants the Company access to and the right to use its hosting system, software and Content administration tools. This is the only grant running *to* us; the Section 6.1 trademark licence runs from us to HDI, so it is out of scope for this rule.
- **Why it fails:** The rights run to "the Company" only. Our affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are not covered, and there is no notice mechanism to add them — short of even the fallback position.
- **Mitigating points noted, not flagged:** the grant is not expressly revocable at HDI's discretion, and Section 10.3 lets successors and assigns enforce the Agreement, so successor transfer is largely addressed.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** adds a sentence to Section 1.4 extending the access/use rights to our affiliates and contractors, confirming they are not revocable by HDI except on termination under Section 4, and confirming successor transfer — with the affiliates-on-written-notice fallback offered in the comment.
